jobs.title: Loss Prevention Agent
jobs.description:
Loss Prevention Agent

Job Summary:

The primary responsibility of a Loss Prevention Agent & Security Officer at The Westin San Diego Gaslamp Quarter is to ensure the welfare and security of guests, employees, and infrastructure. You will be tasked with conducting regular rounds, attending to urgent situations, monitoring surveillance equipment, and enforcing safety protocols throughout the premises. This role is instrumental in creating a safe and hospitable setting for all patrons.

Benefits:

  • Health care coverage
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid leave encompasses both scheduled time off, like vacation days, and unscheduled time off, such as sick days
  • Life and disability insurance serve as crucial safety nets for individuals and their families by providing financial stability during difficult times. These insurance policies can help ease the financial burden that comes with unexpected events, such as illness, injury, or death
  • Wellness programs

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform regular checks in all sections of the property and support guests in gaining room entry.
  • Supervise surveillance cameras, intrusion alerts, and emergency response mechanisms.
  • Reacting to events, such as accidents, crises, and disturbances.
  • Offer primary aid and CPR support while liaising with emergency responders if required.
  • Escort individuals who do not have authorization out of the premises if needed.
  • Create comprehensive documentation of incidents and operational tasks; oversee the upkeep of security registers.
  • Inspect for safety risks and document maintenance concerns.
  • Ensure that doors are locked or unlocked as per the designated timings.
  • Ensure the privacy of reports and confidential data.
  • Offer support for investigations by interviewing relevant parties as necessary.
  • Ensure strict compliance with the company's safety and security protocols.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Educational Qualification: Possession of a high school diploma or a comparable GED qualification.
  • No prior exposure necessary for this position.
  • Licenses or certifications are not obligatory, although state-specific prerequisites might need to be met.
  • Required to lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds and demonstrate agility during unexpected events.
  • Proficient in communicating clearly through both spoken and written language.
  • Maintaining a sense of tranquility when faced with pressure and managing conflicts in a mature manner.

About Us:

We at Westin, which is under the umbrella of Marriott International, are devoted to supporting our guests and staff to reach their maximum potential. Our ethos revolves around promoting well-being, inclusivity, and opportunities for all. Join us as we strive to build a stable and nurturing environment where both guests and team members can prosper.

jobs.title: Security Officer Access Control Compliance
jobs.description:
Security Officer Access Control Compliance

Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Access Control Compliance in Lewisville, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Financial Institutions, and more. Join Allied Universal as an Access Control Officer supporting a financial institution location. You will manage entry points, verify credentials, issue and monitor badges, conduct routine patrols, and help to deter security-related incidents through a visible presence. Deliver exceptional customer service and clear communication while working with a team that is agile, reliable, innovative, caring, and committed to integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $25.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

Day

Time

Mon

02:00 PM - 10:00 PM

Tue

02:00 PM - 10:00 PM

Sat

10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

Sun

02:00 PM - 10:00 PM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to clients, visitors, and employees at a financial institution by carrying out access-control procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Monitor entry and exit points, verify authorization credentials, and manage visitor access in accordance with established procedures.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, promptly communicating observations to appropriate personnel.
  • Maintain accurate access-related logs, visitor records, and incident documentation as required by site procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of access points, lobby areas, and the business perimeter to help to deter unauthorized activity.
Minimum Requirements:
  • At least 2 years of Security Experience is required.
  • Access Control/Badge Experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.
Why Join Us:
  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com. If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Security Facility Supervisor (Unarmed)
jobs.description:
Overview

Every Tarian Teammate contributes significantly to our mission. Whether you are a frontline employee or work behind the scenes, you are the reason why Tarian is TRUSTED TO PROTECT. You are a member of a diverse team working in an inclusive and dynamic environment. You will provide direct security and related public services.

Compensation: $25.74/ hourly.

Benefits:

Our full-time positions offer role specific on-the-job training, career paths, and a full range of benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Supplemental Medical Reimbursement Plans
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays*
  • 401k Plan & Free Retirement Planning Consulting
  • Short-term & Long-term Disability Income Protection Benefits
  • Life Insurance for Teammate and Family
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Recognition & Reward Program
  • Perks Discount Programs with 3,000 free classes from yoga to financial wellness
  • Wellness Program
  • Pet Insurance

POSITION SUMMARY:

Oversees facility security functions by leading assigned teams, coordinating site operations, and implementing procedures to maintain safety, security, and operational effectiveness.


Responsibilities

You will conduct the following responsibilities, upholding Tarian’s commitment to safety and security while supporting the values and culture of the client and community.

  • Manages daily work assignments and schedules to include the daily schedule of all assigned Tarian's personnel.
  • Manages time sheet processing, overtime utilization, and Vision accuracy.
  • May conduct off-hours inspections of employees and program elements.
  • Develops and updates Facility Orders and Competency Tasks.
  • Oversees the assigned work group and/or location(s); maintains Tarian's equipment and supplies.
  • Provides facility employee involvement/security awareness educational programs and workshops.
  • Proactively leads, manages and develops direct reports.
  • Develops and manages competency tasks and procedures.
  • Analyzes department functions and make suggestions, recommendations or changes when appropriate to increase effectiveness and productivity.
  • Writes reports / reviews reports from others and assesses situations for potential negative impact.
  • Interacts with various departments and leaders of the facility to effectively implement the security program.
  • Identifies program issues and potential negative situations; develops and formulates possible solutions; reports possible countermeasures to appropriate leaders.
  • Performs duties of a security officer and/or supervisor as needed which includes, but is not limited to:
  • Provides a visible deterrence to crime, prohibited activities, or suspicious activities in public and non-public areas which may include but is not limited to areas such as the main building, outlying buildings, grounds, parking areas, stairways, tunnels, mechanical areas, or patient treatment areas.
  • Responds quickly and effectively to emergency and non-emergency situations.
  • Escorts persons and assist facility personnel.
  • Constantly alert and vigilant for activities which could result in injury to a person or damage to or loss of property.
  • Enforces and abides by all regulations and guidelines of the facility, PACT/BeST and Tarian.
  • Verbally intervenes during crisis. This includes the functional ability to quickly grasp stressful situations, develop rapport with uncooperative individuals, understand when people are or are not processing information, and be supportive or directive as needed.
  • Ability to physically intervene when people are in crisis. This includes the functional ability to physically restrain people, requiring retention of trained knowledge under stress as well as the ability to meet significant physical demands including those of a struggle with someone physically stronger, while making all possible efforts not to inflict injury. It includes the ability to continue to request or direct compliance from people while they are being restrained.
  • Communicates effectively with diverse people including clients or their representatives, client employees, visitors, or client vendors.
  • Maintains a thorough knowledge of a facility and, where applicable, of multiple facilities.
  • Maintains a positive working relationship with the facility security representatives, local public safety agencies, and Tarian's administration.
  • Participates on facility committees and interfaces with appropriate facility departments.
  • Ensures applicable paperwork/computer data are properly documented and followed up.
  • Attends Tarian and facility conferences and meetings as scheduled.
  • Apply Tarian's use of Force Policy appropriately
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Completed High School Diploma or GED
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Social Science, Behavioral Health or related discipline preferred and/or the equivalent of education and experience.
  • IAHSS Basic Officer, Advanced Officer, and Supervisor Training Certification within 6 months of assignment; must have Certified Healthcare Protection Administrator Certificate within one year of eligibility.
  • Minimum of two to three years supervisory experience and background in management in a service setting.
  • One year of mental health experience preferred.
  • Prefer experience and training in dealing with behavioral health patients and other aggressive or “At Risk” persons and related staff/patient safety situations.
  • Ability to read, write, speak and comprehend English language proficiently.
  • Strong public speaking skills to participate in and/or lead a committee meeting.
  • Ability to effectively write analytical reports, routine reports and correspondence and proofread team member reports for such things as correct spelling, grammar and clarity.
  • Ability to build positive working relationships and demonstrate accountability.
  • Experience with Vision or other scheduling systems is a plus.
  • Experience with data analytics preferred.
  • Proficient in basic computer skills and ability to learn Vision labor management software and incident reporting software.
  • Excellent customer service skills and genuine desire to assist people and provide protection.
  • Manages security program operations duties which include but are not limited to:
  • Managing multiple tasks simultaneously and quickly identify potential negative or dangerous situations and implement effective countermeasures.
  • Manage and motivate a diverse workforce, monitor and measure employee performance and provide appropriate feedback.
  • Ability to meet Tarian's driving requirements and maintain a valid driver’s license.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain any applicable jurisdictional security license(s) or certifications and/or client/contract specific licenses or certifications

Employment Verification
For applicable roles, previous employment must be verified through our background vendor. If any employment cannot be confirmed, candidates may be required to provide proof of employment (such as a pay stubs or W-2s).

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work hours will vary depending on assignments, client schedules, project deadlines, and the needs of the company. Workweeks may exceed 40 hours and may involve any of the 7 days of the week, depending on the needs of the business. The work environment may be fast-paced and stressful or may also be quiet and slow-paced. All environments and...

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Silver Shield Inc. currently seeking a dedicated and experienced Security Officer to join our team.
The Security Officer will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our clients, employees, and visitors.
This position requires strong surveillance skills, conflict management abilities, and knowledge of law enforcement procedures.
Shifts Available:
Evening overnight and weekend shifts available
Duties:
* Patrol assigned areas on foot or in a vehicle to ensure the safety and security of the premises.
* Monitor surveillance cameras and alarm systems to detect any suspicious activity.
* Respond to alarms and investigate disturbances.
* Provide assistance and guidance to employees and visitors in emergency situations.
* Enforce company policies and procedures to maintain order and prevent unauthorized access.
* Conduct regular inspections to identify potential security risks or hazards.
* Write detailed incident reports and maintain accurate records of daily activities.
* Collaborate with local law enforcement agencies when necessary.
Skills:
* Strong surveillance skills to effectively monitor premises using CCTV systems.
* Excellent conflict management abilities to handle difficult situations calmly and professionally.
* Knowledge of law enforcement procedures, including arrest techniques and legal rights.
* CPR certification and first aid training to provide immediate medical assistance if needed.
* Familiarity with loss prevention strategies to prevent theft or damage to property.
Requirements:
* High school diploma or equivalent
* Proven work experience as a Security Officer or in a similar role preferred
* Must possess a valid driver's license
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening
We will help you get your Level II certification within the first 30 days if you don’t already have it.
